scope: Full Oop image owner roundtrip and twenty-resave stability with independent resident controls

resave_validation.comparison: Each parity must match its observed baseline from epoch 3 onward: retained fact count, retained fact bytes, live native units and complete image size. Every epoch also releases fixture mappings against an independent resident control.
resave_validation.source_variance_note: The resave executable was copied before correcting removed direct-binding queries in the roundtrip-only helper/assertions. The resave path and its shared setup/cleanup were unchanged. Roundtrip ran the final source, and the C fixture was unchanged throughout.
